title: Tencent denies plans to cut half its workforce, says AI restructuring remarks were misinterpreted
summary: Tencent has denied reports that it plans to lay off 50 per cent of its workforce, clarifying that recent management comments about reorganising resources for artificial intelligence (AI) adoption were not an indication of mass job cuts. llm_summary: Tencent has refuted rumors that it will cut 50 % of its staff, explaining that recent comments about reorganising resources for AI adoption were about strategic realignment—not mass layoffs. The clarification comes after an internal event celebrating the company's 28th anniversary sparked widespread speculation on Chinese social media.
